AssociateLenses.name: AssociateLenses
AssociateLenses.documentation:
Associate a lens to a workload.

Up to 10 lenses can be associated with a workload in a single API operation. A maximum of 20 lenses can be associated with a workload.

Disclaimer

By accessing and/or applying custom lenses created by another Amazon Web Services user or account, you acknowledge that custom lenses created by other users and shared with you are Third Party Content as defined in the Amazon Web Services Customer Agreement.

CreateAgentBasicProfile.name: CreateAgentBasicProfile
CreateAgentBasicProfile.documentation: Creates a Basic profile for the calling account. No configuration input is required because the account and region are inferred from the caller. The profile uses the reserved name basic. This operation is idempotent. Calling it twice returns the same ARN. Each account can have at most one Basic profile.

CreateAgentContext.name: CreateAgentContext
CreateAgentContext.documentation: Creates a context associated with an optimization profile. Contexts provide application and environment information used during recommendation generation.

CreateAgentGoal.name: CreateAgentGoal
CreateAgentGoal.documentation: Creates an optimization goal associated with a profile. Goals define specific targets and objectives for the optimization process.

CreateAgentOrganizationalProfile.name: CreateAgentOrganizationalProfile
CreateAgentOrganizationalProfile.documentation: Creates an Organizational Profile for use with AWS Organizations integration. Organizational Profiles are scoped to an AWS Organization and do not require an execution role or aggregation configuration. The organization is inferred from the caller's identity.

CreateAgentOrganizationalReport.name: CreateAgentOrganizationalReport
CreateAgentOrganizationalReport.documentation: Creates an Organizational Report, which is an asynchronously-materialized, point-in-time snapshot of recommendations across all Agent Profiles within the caller's AWS Organization. You can optionally narrow the scope with filters. The operation is idempotent on the caller-supplied clientToken. The AWS Organization the report belongs to is inferred from the caller's authorization context. Reports are retained for 90 days from creation, after which they are automatically deleted. Use DeleteAgentOrganizationalReport to delete a report earlier.

CreateAgentProfile.name: CreateAgentProfile
CreateAgentProfile.documentation: Creates an optimization profile that defines the scope and configuration for generating recommendations. A profile specifies the execution role, target pillars, and aggregation settings for analyzing your Amazon Web Services resources.

CreateLensShare.name: CreateLensShare
CreateLensShare.documentation:
Create a lens share.

The owner of a lens can share it with other Amazon Web Services accounts, users, an organization, and organizational units (OUs) in the same Amazon Web Services Region. Lenses provided by Amazon Web Services (Amazon Web Services Official Content) cannot be shared.

Shared access to a lens is not removed until the lens invitation is deleted.

If you share a lens with an organization or OU, all accounts in the organization or OU are granted access to the lens.

For more information, see Sharing a custom lens in the Well-Architected Tool User Guide.

Disclaimer

By sharing your custom lenses with other Amazon Web Services accounts, you acknowledge that Amazon Web Services will make your custom lenses available to those other accounts. Those other accounts may continue to access and use your shared custom lenses even if you delete the custom lenses from your own Amazon Web Services account or terminate your Amazon Web Services account.

CreateLensVersion.name: CreateLensVersion
CreateLensVersion.documentation:
Create a new lens version.

A lens can have up to 100 versions.

Use this operation to publish a new lens version after you have imported a lens. The LensAlias is used to identify the lens to be published. The owner of a lens can share the lens with other Amazon Web Services accounts and users in the same Amazon Web Services Region. Only the owner of a lens can delete it.

CreateMilestone.name: CreateMilestone
CreateMilestone.documentation: Create a milestone for an existing workload.

CreateReviewTemplate.name: CreateReviewTemplate
CreateReviewTemplate.documentation:
Create a review template.

Disclaimer

Do not include or gather personal identifiable information (PII) of end users or other identifiable individuals in or via your review templates. If your review template or those shared with you and used in your account do include or collect PII you are responsible for: ensuring that the included PII is processed in accordance with applicable law, providing adequate privacy notices, and obtaining necessary consents for processing such data.

CreateTemplateShare.name: CreateTemplateShare
CreateTemplateShare.documentation:
Create a review template share.

The owner of a review template can share it with other Amazon Web Services accounts, users, an organization, and organizational units (OUs) in the same Amazon Web Services Region.

Shared access to a review template is not removed until the review template share invitation is deleted.

If you share a review template with an organization or OU, all accounts in the organization or OU are granted access to the review template.

Disclaimer

By sharing your review template with other Amazon Web Services accounts, you acknowledge that Amazon Web Services will make your review template available to those other accounts.

CreateWorkload.name: CreateWorkload
CreateWorkload.documentation:
Create a new workload.

The owner of a workload can share the workload with other Amazon Web Services accounts, users, an organization, and organizational units (OUs) in the same Amazon Web Services Region. Only the owner of a workload can delete it.

For more information, see Defining a Workload in the Well-Architected Tool User Guide.

Either AwsRegions, NonAwsRegions, or both must be specified when creating a workload.

You also must specify ReviewOwner, even though the parameter is listed as not being required in the following section.

When creating a workload using a review template, you must have the following IAM permissions:

  • wellarchitected:GetReviewTemplate

  • wellarchitected:GetReviewTemplateAnswer

  • wellarchitected:ListReviewTemplateAnswers

  • wellarchitected:GetReviewTemplateLensReview

CreateWorkloadShare.name: CreateWorkloadShare
CreateWorkloadShare.documentation:
Create a workload share.

The owner of a workload can share it with other Amazon Web Services accounts and users in the same Amazon Web Services Region. Shared access to a workload is not removed until the workload invitation is deleted.

If you share a workload with an organization or OU, all accounts in the organization or OU are granted access to the workload.

For more information, see Sharing a workload in the Well-Architected Tool User Guide.

DeleteAgentContext.name: DeleteAgentContext
DeleteAgentContext.documentation: Deletes a context associated with a profile.

DeleteAgentGoal.name: DeleteAgentGoal
DeleteAgentGoal.documentation: Deletes an optimization goal from a profile.

DeleteAgentOrganizationalReport.name: DeleteAgentOrganizationalReport
DeleteAgentOrganizationalReport.documentation: Deletes an Organizational Report and its associated artifacts. The operation is idempotent, so repeated calls for a report that has already been deleted return success.

DeleteAgentProfile.name: DeleteAgentProfile
DeleteAgentProfile.documentation: Deletes an optimization profile and its associated configuration. This action cannot be undone.

DeleteAgentProfilePolicy.name: DeleteAgentProfilePolicy
DeleteAgentProfilePolicy.documentation: Removes the resource-based policy from an Agent Profile. This revokes all cross-account access previously granted by the policy. Only the profile owner can call this operation.

DeleteAgentRecommendationPolicy.name: DeleteAgentRecommendationPolicy
DeleteAgentRecommendationPolicy.documentation: Removes the resource-based policy from an individual Agent Recommendation. This revokes all cross-account access previously granted by the policy. The recommendation owner or any principal with profile write access on the parent profile can call this operation.

DeleteLens.name: DeleteLens
DeleteLens.documentation:
Delete an existing lens.

Only the owner of a lens can delete it. After the lens is deleted, Amazon Web Services accounts and users that you shared the lens with can continue to use it, but they will no longer be able to apply it to new workloads.

Disclaimer

By sharing your custom lenses with other Amazon Web Services accounts, you acknowledge that Amazon Web Services will make your custom lenses available to those other accounts. Those other accounts may continue to access and use your shared custom lenses even if you delete the custom lenses from your own Amazon Web Services account or terminate your Amazon Web Services account.

DeleteLensShare.name: DeleteLensShare
DeleteLensShare.documentation:
Delete a lens share.

After the lens share is deleted, Amazon Web Services accounts, users, organizations, and organizational units (OUs) that you shared the lens with can continue to use it, but they will no longer be able to apply it to new workloads.

Disclaimer

By sharing your custom lenses with other Amazon Web Services accounts, you acknowledge that Amazon Web Services will make your custom lenses available to those other accounts. Those other accounts may continue to access and use your shared custom lenses even if you delete the custom lenses from your own Amazon Web Services account or terminate your Amazon Web Services account.

DeleteProfile.name: DeleteProfile
DeleteProfile.documentation:
Delete a profile.

Disclaimer

By sharing your profile with other Amazon Web Services accounts, you acknowledge that Amazon Web Services will make your profile available to those other accounts. Those other accounts may continue to access and use your shared profile even if you delete the profile from your own Amazon Web Services account or terminate your Amazon Web Services account.

DeleteReviewTemplate.name: DeleteReviewTemplate
DeleteReviewTemplate.documentation:
Delete a review template.

Only the owner of a review template can delete it.

After the review template is deleted, Amazon Web Services accounts, users, organizations, and organizational units (OUs) that you shared the review template with will no longer be able to apply it to new workloads.

DeleteTemplateShare.name: DeleteTemplateShare
DeleteTemplateShare.documentation:
Delete a review template share.

After the review template share is deleted, Amazon Web Services accounts, users, organizations, and organizational units (OUs) that you shared the review template with will no longer be able to apply it to new workloads.

DisassociateLenses.name: DisassociateLenses
DisassociateLenses.documentation:
Disassociate a lens from a workload.

Up to 10 lenses can be disassociated from a workload in a single API operation.

The Amazon Web Services Well-Architected Framework lens (wellarchitected) cannot be removed from a workload.

ExportLens.name: ExportLens
ExportLens.documentation:
Export an existing lens.

Only the owner of a lens can export it. Lenses provided by Amazon Web Services (Amazon Web Services Official Content) cannot be exported.

Lenses are defined in JSON. For more information, see JSON format specification in the Well-Architected Tool User Guide.

Disclaimer

Do not include or gather personal identifiable information (PII) of end users or other identifiable individuals in or via your custom lenses. If your custom lens or those shared with you and used in your account do include or collect PII you are responsible for: ensuring that the included PII is processed in accordance with applicable law, providing adequate privacy notices, and obtaining necessary consents for processing such data.

GetAgentContext.name: GetAgentContext
GetAgentContext.documentation: Retrieves detailed information about a specific context associated with a profile.

GetAgentGoal.name: GetAgentGoal
GetAgentGoal.documentation: Retrieves detailed information about a specific optimization goal.

GetAgentOrganizationalReport.name: GetAgentOrganizationalReport
GetAgentOrganizationalReport.documentation: Retrieves metadata and current state for a single Organizational Report. The coverageSummary is populated once the report reaches COMPLETED and is absent for reports still in progress or in a failed state.

GetAgentOrganizationalReportData.name: GetAgentOrganizationalReportData
GetAgentOrganizationalReportData.documentation: Retrieves the data artifact for a completed Organizational Report as a short-lived presigned S3 URL. The response contains the URL in downloadUrl and its expiration in expiresAt. To have the service write the artifact directly into a caller-owned bucket instead, use SendAgentOrganizationalReportDataToS3.

GetAgentPreferences.name: GetAgentPreferences
GetAgentPreferences.documentation: Returns the caller's complete set of Well-Architected Agent preferences with their current states.

GetAgentProfile.name: GetAgentProfile
GetAgentProfile.documentation: Retrieves detailed information about an optimization profile, including its configuration and metadata.

GetAgentProfilePolicy.name: GetAgentProfilePolicy
GetAgentProfilePolicy.documentation: Retrieves the resource-based policy attached to an Agent Profile. Only the profile owner can call this operation.

GetAgentRecommendation.name: GetAgentRecommendation
GetAgentRecommendation.documentation:
Application-level recommendations are a new recommendation format currently in beta. We are actively seeking customer feedback to improve their quality and relevance. As with any AI-generated content, please thoroughly review each recommendation before taking any action based on it.

Retrieves detailed information about a specific optimization recommendation, including its impact analysis, content, and implementation guidance.

GetAgentRecommendationGeneration.name: GetAgentRecommendationGeneration
GetAgentRecommendationGeneration.documentation:
Application-level recommendations are a new recommendation format currently in beta. We are actively seeking customer feedback to improve their quality and relevance. As with any AI-generated content, please thoroughly review each recommendation before taking any action based on it.

Retrieves information about a recommendation generation process, including its status, progress, and results. Recommendation generation is asynchronous: poll this operation until status reaches a terminal value of COMPLETED (results are ready) or ERROR (see errorDetails). Intermediate values are QUEUED and IN_PROGRESS.

GetAgentRecommendationPolicy.name: GetAgentRecommendationPolicy
GetAgentRecommendationPolicy.documentation: Retrieves the resource-based policy attached to an individual Agent Recommendation. The recommendation owner or any principal with profile write access on the parent profile can call this operation.

GetAnswer.name: GetAnswer
GetAnswer.documentation: Get the answer to a specific question in a workload review.

GetConsolidatedReport.name: GetConsolidatedReport
GetConsolidatedReport.documentation:
Get a consolidated report of your workloads.

You can optionally choose to include workloads that have been shared with you.

GetMilestone.name: GetMilestone
GetMilestone.documentation: Get a milestone for an existing workload.

GetReviewTemplateLensReview.name: GetReviewTemplateLensReview
GetReviewTemplateLensReview.documentation: Get a lens review associated with a review template.

ImportLens.name: ImportLens
ImportLens.documentation:
Import a new custom lens or update an existing custom lens.

To update an existing custom lens, specify its ARN as the LensAlias. If no ARN is specified, a new custom lens is created.

The new or updated lens will have a status of DRAFT. The lens cannot be applied to workloads or shared with other Amazon Web Services accounts until it's published with CreateLensVersion.

Lenses are defined in JSON. For more information, see JSON format specification in the Well-Architected Tool User Guide.

A custom lens cannot exceed 500 KB in size.

Disclaimer

Do not include or gather personal identifiable information (PII) of end users or other identifiable individuals in or via your custom lenses. If your custom lens or those shared with you and used in your account do include or collect PII you are responsible for: ensuring that the included PII is processed in accordance with applicable law, providing adequate privacy notices, and obtaining necessary consents for processing such data.

ListAgentGoals.name: ListAgentGoals
ListAgentGoals.documentation: Lists optimization goals associated with a specified profile. Goals define specific targets and objectives for the optimization process.

ListAgentOrganizationalReports.name: ListAgentOrganizationalReports
ListAgentOrganizationalReports.documentation: Lists Organizational Reports owned by the caller's account within the caller's AWS Organization, ordered by most recently created first. Supports pagination and an optional state filter.

ListAgentProfiles.name: ListAgentProfiles
ListAgentProfiles.documentation: Lists optimization profiles in your account. Profiles define the scope and configuration for generating optimization recommendations.

ListAgentRecommendationGenerations.name: ListAgentRecommendationGenerations
ListAgentRecommendationGenerations.documentation:
Application-level recommendations are a new recommendation format currently in beta. We are actively seeking customer feedback to improve their quality and relevance. As with any AI-generated content, please thoroughly review each recommendation before taking any action based on it.

Lists recommendation generation processes for a specified profile.

ListAgentRecommendationItems.name: ListAgentRecommendationItems
ListAgentRecommendationItems.documentation:
Application-level recommendations are a new recommendation format currently in beta. We are actively seeking customer feedback to improve their quality and relevance. As with any AI-generated content, please thoroughly review each recommendation before taking any action based on it.

Lists recommendation items for a specific recommendation. Recommendation items provide detailed information about individual optimization opportunities.

ListAgentRecommendations.name: ListAgentRecommendations
ListAgentRecommendations.documentation:
Application-level recommendations are a new recommendation format currently in beta. We are actively seeking customer feedback to improve their quality and relevance. As with any AI-generated content, please thoroughly review each recommendation before taking any action based on it.

Lists active optimization recommendations for a specified profile with optional filtering by state.

ListAnswers.name: ListAnswers
ListAnswers.documentation: List of answers for a particular workload and lens.

ListCheckDetails.name: ListCheckDetails
ListCheckDetails.documentation: List of Trusted Advisor check details by account related to the workload.

ListCheckSummaries.name: ListCheckSummaries
ListCheckSummaries.documentation: List of Trusted Advisor checks summarized for all accounts related to the workload.

ListLensReviewImprovements.name: ListLensReviewImprovements
ListLensReviewImprovements.documentation: List the improvements of a particular lens review.

ListLensReviews.name: ListLensReviews
ListLensReviews.documentation: List lens reviews for a particular workload.

ListLensShares.name: ListLensShares
ListLensShares.documentation: List the lens shares associated with the lens.

ListMilestones.name: ListMilestones
ListMilestones.documentation: List all milestones for an existing workload.

ListReviewTemplateAnswers.name: ListReviewTemplateAnswers
ListReviewTemplateAnswers.documentation: List the answers of a review template.

ListShareInvitations.name: ListShareInvitations
ListShareInvitations.documentation:
List the share invitations.

WorkloadNamePrefix, LensNamePrefix, ProfileNamePrefix, and TemplateNamePrefix are mutually exclusive. Use the parameter that matches your ShareResourceType.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.documentation:
List the tags for a resource.

The WorkloadArn parameter can be a workload ARN, a custom lens ARN, a profile ARN, or review template ARN.

ListWorkloadShares.name: ListWorkloadShares
ListWorkloadShares.documentation: List the workload shares associated with the workload.

PutAgentPreferences.name: PutAgentPreferences
PutAgentPreferences.documentation: Creates or replaces the caller's Well-Architected Agent preferences. Each supplied update sets the desired state of one preference. Preferences not named in the request are left unchanged. Enabling or disabling is performed synchronously, so a failure to reach the requested state is returned as a modeled exception rather than a FAILED status. On success the operation returns an empty response. Call GetAgentPreferences to read the resulting state. The account the preferences belong to is inferred from the caller's authorization context.

PutAgentProfilePolicy.name: PutAgentProfilePolicy
PutAgentProfilePolicy.documentation: Attaches or replaces a resource-based policy on an Agent Profile. The policy controls cross-account access to the profile and its child resources such as recommendations, goals, and contexts. Only the profile owner can call this operation. The policy must be valid IAM JSON with Allow-only statements and no negation condition operators.

PutAgentRecommendationFeedback.name: PutAgentRecommendationFeedback
PutAgentRecommendationFeedback.documentation: Submits user feedback on a recommendation to help improve future optimization suggestions and track implementation outcomes.

PutAgentRecommendationPolicy.name: PutAgentRecommendationPolicy
PutAgentRecommendationPolicy.documentation: Attaches or replaces a resource-based policy on an individual Agent Recommendation. The policy controls cross-account access to the recommendation and its child resources such as items and remediations. The recommendation owner or any principal with profile write access on the parent profile can call this operation. The policy must be valid IAM JSON with Allow-only statements and no negation condition operators.

SendAgentOrganizationalReportDataToS3.name: SendAgentOrganizationalReportDataToS3
SendAgentOrganizationalReportDataToS3.documentation: Writes the data artifact for a completed Organizational Report directly into a caller-owned S3 bucket. The artifact is written in the requested format to the supplied bucketArn and objectKey, and the resulting S3 location is returned in deliveredTo. This operation creates an S3 object and should not be retried indiscriminately. To download the artifact through a short-lived presigned URL instead, use GetAgentOrganizationalReportData.

StartAgentRecommendationGeneration.name: StartAgentRecommendationGeneration
StartAgentRecommendationGeneration.documentation:
Starts a recommendation generation process for the specified agent profile. This asynchronous operation returns immediately. Use GetAgentRecommendationGeneration to check the status of the generation.

Currently, only the ARCHITECTURE recommendation type is supported. RESOURCE and APPLICATION recommendations are generated only by the scheduled generation cycle and cannot be started with this operation.

For the ARCHITECTURE type, the generation analyzes the infrastructure as code (IaC) template that you specify in additionalContext, and returns updated templates with best practice fixes applied. You must specify scope and additionalContext. You can optionally specify name.

Architecture review generations are subject to a daily quota for each profile. For more information, see Quotas and limits in the Amazon Web Services Well-Architected User Guide.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.documentation:
Adds one or more tags to the specified resource.

The WorkloadArn parameter can be a workload ARN, a custom lens ARN, a profile ARN, or review template ARN.

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.documentation:
Deletes specified tags from a resource.

The WorkloadArn parameter can be a workload ARN, a custom lens ARN, a profile ARN, or review template ARN.

To specify multiple tags, use separate tagKeys parameters, for example:

DELETE /tags/WorkloadArn?tagKeys=key1&tagKeys=key2

UpdateAgentContext.name: UpdateAgentContext
UpdateAgentContext.documentation: Updates an existing context associated with a profile.

UpdateAgentGoal.name: UpdateAgentGoal
UpdateAgentGoal.documentation: Updates the pillars and title of an existing goal associated with a profile.

UpdateAgentOrganizationalProfile.name: UpdateAgentOrganizationalProfile
UpdateAgentOrganizationalProfile.documentation:
Updates an Organizational Profile. Organizational Profiles are specific to Profiles created using AWS Organizations integration. Include only the fields you want to change; any field you omit from the request keeps its current value.

To clear an optional text field, supply an empty string for it; the field is then unset, and a subsequent read omits it rather than returning an empty string. Omitting the field from the request leaves the stored value in place. description and businessOverview can be cleared this way. displayName cannot be cleared because a display name is required, though you can change it. pillars cannot be cleared because a profile must target at least one pillar.

organizationalAggregationConfiguration behaves differently because it is a structure rather than a text field. Supplying it with both its organizationalUnits and accounts lists empty removes every monitored organizational unit and account, but the field itself remains set: a subsequent read returns the structure with two empty lists rather than omitting it. Omitting the field from the request keeps the stored boundary.

UpdateAgentProfile.name: UpdateAgentProfile
UpdateAgentProfile.documentation:
Updates an existing optimization profile's configuration, including its pillars, execution role, and aggregation settings. Include only the fields you want to change. Any field you omit from the request keeps its current value, so you do not need to retrieve the profile first and resend the fields you are not changing.

To clear an optional text field, supply an empty string for it; the field is then unset, and a subsequent read omits it rather than returning an empty string. Omitting the field from the request leaves the stored value in place. description and businessOverview can be cleared this way. displayName cannot be cleared because a display name is required, though you can change it. pillars cannot be cleared because a profile must target at least one pillar.

aggregationConfiguration behaves differently because it is a list of per-account configurations rather than a text field. Supplying an empty list removes every account entry, but the field itself remains set: a subsequent read returns an empty list rather than omitting the field. Omitting it from the request keeps the stored entries.

UpdateAgentRecommendationStatus.name: UpdateAgentRecommendationStatus
UpdateAgentRecommendationStatus.documentation: Updates the status of a recommendation to track its progress through the implementation lifecycle.

UpdateAnswer.name: UpdateAnswer
UpdateAnswer.documentation: Update the answer to a specific question in a workload review.

UpdateGlobalSettings.name: UpdateGlobalSettings
UpdateGlobalSettings.documentation: Update whether the Amazon Web Services account is opted into organization sharing and discovery integration features.

UpdateLensReview.name: UpdateLensReview
UpdateLensReview.documentation: Update lens review for a particular workload.

UpdateReviewTemplateLensReview.name: UpdateReviewTemplateLensReview
UpdateReviewTemplateLensReview.documentation: Update a lens review associated with a review template.

UpdateShareInvitation.name: UpdateShareInvitation
UpdateShareInvitation.documentation:
Update a workload or custom lens share invitation.

This API operation can be called independently of any resource. Previous documentation implied that a workload ARN must be specified.

UpgradeLensReview.name: UpgradeLensReview
UpgradeLensReview.documentation: Upgrade lens review for a particular workload.

UpgradeReviewTemplateLensReview.name: UpgradeReviewTemplateLensReview
UpgradeReviewTemplateLensReview.documentation: Upgrade the lens review of a review template.

AccessDeniedException.documentation: User does not have sufficient access to perform this action.

JiraProjectKey.documentation: Account-level: Jira project key to sync workloads to.

IntegrationStatus.documentation: Account-level: Configuration status of the Jira integration.
Account-level: Configuration status of the Jira integration.

JiraProjectKey.documentation: Account-level: Jira project key to sync workloads to.

StatusMessage.documentation: Account-level: Status message on configuration of the Jira integration.

AccountJiraConfigurationOutput.documentation: Account-level: Output configuration of the Jira integration.

AccountSummary.documentation: Account summary for a Well-Architected best practice in relation to Trusted Advisor checks.

Type.documentation: Type of additional resource for a custom lens.

Content.documentation: The URLs for additional resources, either helpful resources or improvement plans, for a custom lens. Up to five additional URLs can be specified.

AdditionalResources.documentation:
The choice level additional resources for a custom lens.

This field does not apply to Amazon Web Services official lenses.

displayName.documentation: The display name of the profile shown to users.

pillars.documentation: The Amazon Web Services Well-Architected Framework pillars associated with this profile. Not present for basic profiles.

deletionProtection.documentation: Indicates whether deletion protection is enabled for the profile.

executionRoleArn.documentation: The ARN of the IAM execution role used for recommendation actions. Not present for basic profiles.

aggregationConfiguration.documentation: The aggregation configuration that defines which Amazon Web Services accounts and Regions to analyze. Not present for basic profiles.

arn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the optimization profile.

eligibleForScheduledGeneration.documentation: Indicates whether the profile is valid for scheduled recommendation generation.

eligibleForArchitectureGeneration.documentation: Indicates whether the profile is valid for manual architecture generation.

fieldErrors.documentation: A map of field paths to error messages for invalid or missing input fields.

createdBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that created this profile.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the profile was created.

lastModifiedBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that last modified this profile.

lastModifiedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the profile was last modified.

organizationalAggregationConfiguration.documentation: The organizational monitoring boundary. Present only for organizational profiles.

AgentProfileSummary.documentation: Summary of an optimization profile, including its configuration, metadata, and audit information.

id.documentation: The unique identifier of the recommendation generation.

profileArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the profile used for this generation.

status.documentation: The current status of the recommendation generation.

estimatedCompletionTime.documentation: The estimated time for the generation to complete.

createdBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that started this generation.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the generation was started.

lastModifiedBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that last modified this generation.

lastModifiedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the generation was last modified.

startedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the recommendation generation process started.

endedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the recommendation generation process completed.

errorDetails.documentation: Details about the error if the generation status is ERROR.

AgentRecommendationGenerationSummary.documentation: Summary of a recommendation generation process initiated through the agent API.

id.documentation: The unique identifier of the recommendation item.

recommendationArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the associated recommendation.

metadata.documentation: Metadata containing a snapshot of the resource or recommendation at the time of generation.

createdBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that created this recommendation item.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the recommendation item was created.

lastModifiedBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that last modified this recommendation item.

lastModifiedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the recommendation item was last modified.

autoRemediation.documentation: The optional per-resource auto-remediation for this affected resource, representing an SSM runbook execution. Present only when the item's check is backed by an SSM automation runbook.

AgentRecommendationItemSummary.documentation: Summary of an agent recommendation item, representing an Amazon Web Services resource or recommendation affected by the optimization recommendation.

recommendationArn.documentation: The ARN of the recommendation that this remediation belongs to.

steps.documentation: The procedural steps to perform the remediation.

createdBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that created this remediation.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the remediation was created.

lastModifiedBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that last modified this remediation.

lastModifiedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the remediation was last modified.

recommendationArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the recommendation.

profileArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the associated profile.

generationId.documentation: The identifier of the generation that produced this recommendation.

pillar.documentation: The Amazon Web Services Well-Architected Framework pillar that the recommendation addresses.

effort.documentation: The effort required to implement the recommendation.

updateReason.documentation: The free-text reason associated with the recommendation's most recent status update.

roi.documentation: The return on investment estimate for the recommendation.

numberOfResources.documentation: The number of Amazon Web Services resources this recommendation affects.

awsServices.documentation: The Amazon Web Services services that the recommendation applies to.

businessUnits.documentation: The business units that own the affected resources.

createdBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that created this recommendation.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the recommendation was created.

lastModifiedBy.documentation: The identifier of the user or system that last modified this recommendation.

lastModifiedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the recommendation was last modified.

AgentRecommendationSummary.documentation: Summary of an agent optimization recommendation returned by list operations.

accountId.documentation: The Amazon Web Services account ID to analyze.

regions.documentation: A list of Amazon Web Services Regions to include in the analysis.

accessRoleArn.documentation: The ARN of an IAM role to assume for resource analysis in this account.

AggregationConfiguration.documentation: Configuration settings that define the scope of Amazon Web Services resources to analyze for optimization recommendations.

HelpfulResourceDisplayText.documentation:
The helpful resource text to be displayed for a custom lens.

This field does not apply to Amazon Web Services official lenses.

ChoiceAnswers.documentation: A list of selected choices to a question in your workload.

Reason.documentation: The reason why the question is not applicable to your workload.

AnswerSummaries.documentation: List of answer summaries of lens review in a workload.

ChoiceAnswerSummaries.documentation: A list of selected choices to a question in your workload.

Reason.documentation: The reason why a choice is non-applicable to a question in your workload.

AnswerSummary.documentation: An answer summary of a lens review in a workload.

ApplicationType.documentation: The type of application described by an application context.

ProfileArns.documentation: The list of profile ARNs to associate with the workload.

deepLink.documentation: A deep link to the SSM runbook execution page in the AWS Management Console for this resource, with the execution parameters prefilled.

cliCommand.documentation: The AWS CLI command that triggers the same SSM runbook execution for this resource. You can copy and run this command as-is.

AutoRemediation.documentation: The per-resource auto-remediation for a single affected resource. Represents one AWS Systems Manager (SSM) runbook execution that targets the resource. Present only when the resource's check is backed by an SSM automation runbook.

AwsRegion.documentation: An Amazon Web Services Region, for example, us-west-2 or ap-northeast-1.

Base64String.documentation:
The Base64-encoded string representation of a lens review report.

This data can be used to create a PDF file.

Only returned by GetConsolidatedReport when PDF format is requested.

Amazon Web Services Well-Architected

This is the Amazon Web Services Well-Architected API Reference. Amazon Web Services Well-Architected helps you evaluate your architectures against Amazon Web Services best practices across operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.

To view API actions organized by service, see API actions.

Amazon Web Services Well-Architected Agent (preview)

Describes the API operations for managing optimization profiles, goals, application context, and recommendations in the Amazon Web Services Well-Architected Agent. Through this API, you can create and configure agent profiles that define the scope of your Amazon Web Services environment to analyze, set optimization goals across cost, security, performance, and resilience pillars, start recommendation generation, retrieve prioritized recommendations with ready-to-deploy remediation scripts, and provide feedback to improve future recommendations.

For more information, see What is Amazon Web Services Well-Architected Agent?

Well-Architected Tool

Describes the API operations for creating and managing workloads, conducting lens reviews, tracking milestones, managing custom lenses, sharing workloads across accounts, and managing profiles with the Well-Architected Tool.

For more information, see What is Well-Architected Tool?
